decision: L3 replaced: a chain of short intake-large step jobs keyed by stored state. jobs.ts:178 and :189 unchanged; no yield/resume.

job.id: stableUuid('intake-large/1:<sourceId>:<stateKey>'), the digest intakeDraftKey uses (intakeDraftKey becomes a caller of intake-run.ts stableUuid; bounded ids unchanged)
job.insert: lookup by id, INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING, registerUspJobInputTx only for a new row

inputs: reader: job id, state, sealed_chunks, unknown_remainder (usp_streaming_vector_imports, found by the item's stable reader request key in operations)
profile: job id, state, sealed_generation (usp_streamed_profile_imports, stable profile request key)
recipe: id, revision, state (usp_mapping_recipes for the source)
mapping: job id, state, sealed_chunks, unknown_remainder (usp_chunk_mapping_imports, stable mapping key per recipe revision)
parts: count usp_intake_parts for the item
stateKey.notIn: item row, publish indexes, attempts, time

stateTable.rows: item root vector/geojson, source large-original-v1 within 128 MiB, no reader operation row
stateTable.step: StreamingVectorService.enqueue then StreamedProfileService.enqueue with stable request keys (own transactions); final transaction publishes and queues
stateTable.wakes: the step's own final transaction (key now has reader+profile queued)

stateTable.rows: reader queued/running/completed without verified receipt, or profile not sealed at the reader's part count
stateTable.step: enqueue the profile if its stable key is absent; publish
stateTable.wakes: reader terminal transaction; profile seal or terminal failure

stateTable.rows: reader completed and sealed, receipt verified for this raw job, profile sealed at sealed_chunks, no usp_mapping_recipes row

publish.reason: No approved layout matches this file. An officer states what each feature is and which field identifies it.

stateTable.rows: recipe approved; mapping absent, or not closed at the reader's sealed parts and records
stateTable.step: absent: publish planned/approved, enqueue ChunkMappingService (approved recipe, sealed profile pins, stable key per recipe revision), publish reading; present: publish
stateTable.wakes: approve; mapping close or terminal failure

stateTable.rows: mapping closed; parts < cuts; fewer than 8 unreviewed
stateTable.step: publish partsPlanned null/partsDone parts; resume the fold after the last part; draft cuts one transaction each until 8 unreviewed, end of file or 60 s; every cut transaction checks the key it expects and ends with queueIntakeLargeTx
stateTable.wakes: each cut transaction; at 8 unreviewed, intake-run prepare after prepareIntakeTargetsTx/holdPackageTargetsTx

publish.placement: undecided, on_map from the first part

stateTable.rows: 8 published parts whose packages are unreviewed
fold reached end of file in the drafting step
stateTable.step: publish in the last transaction of that step

publish.reason: L6 holds sentence when any record entered no package, else null

stateTable.rows: fold reached end of file with no part rows

publish.reason: L6 sentence (0 in 0 packages, nonzero clauses)

stateTable.rows: reader, profile or mapping failed or stale
stateTable.step: publish the officer sentence of the first failed of reader, profile, mapping; STREAMING_SOURCE_CRS names the card's retained CRS code as the file writes it

stateTable.rows: an intake-large job on its third failed attempt
stateTable.step: the failing attempt's terminal transaction writes the sentence

publish.reason: Preparing this file stopped after repeated errors; the steps already done are kept. Nothing more was prepared from it.

fold.resume: Exact from stored rows. A cut closes when the first non-held observed feature after its last feature L does not fit; held is decided against an empty cut, independently of cutter state. So a cutter created with nextIndex = part count and previous = L, fed features after L, reaches the same state the whole fold had after closing that cut. The held count per part is cumulative through L and stored in its counts.
fold.inputs: raw and mapped chunk payloads through the existing authorized chunk readers, from the first raw slot whose last_feature_index >= L+1; both occurrences of a conflicted key and non-observed records are skipped before the cutter
fold.rawBytes: contiguous original spans of at most 1 MiB through readObjectRange, sliced per feature; provePartFeature rechecks each span's hash

costDA6.partsReread: 0 per step (only the last part row's locator)
costDA6.chunkPairsPerStep: at most 8 x 20 + 1 = 161 (raw and mapped), one chunk pair overlapping the previous cut
costDA6.wholeFile: 487 chunk pairs plus at most one overlap per drafting step

wakeups.site: streaming-vector-worker.ts claim-failure terminal transaction (exhausted or stale before claim)
streamed-mapping.ts author and approve, after the recipe.changed event
intake-run-worker.ts prepare, after prepareIntakeTargetsTx or holdPackageTargetsTx
wakeups.note: reviewPackage commits the review in its own transaction (areas.ts, not owned); the key changes there and the prepare transaction that follows queues it. A stop between them is recovered by the run job's own retry of prepare.

delayedRetry: none for wake-ups; a failed step attempt uses the authority's queued retry after 2 seconds, as the streaming workers do
silentKeyChanges: reader and mapping queued->running transitions are not wake-up sites; a job queued for 'queued' finds its key stale, queues the current key and succeeds

restart.start: no operation row for the reader key; the start job is queued or its attempt lease expires and the authority reclaims it
restart.read: reader/profile rows and their own jobs; the step job for the current key exists because the last state change queued it
restart.question: sealed profile and no recipe; at rest until author
restart.layout: recipe row; job for its key
restart.map: mapping operation row by stable key; enqueue replays the same job
restart.draft: usp_intake_parts rows; the last cut transaction queued the job for the state it left; a resumed fold starts after the last stored locator; draftIntakePartTx refuses a differing cut and a replay writes nothing
restart.end: item state read; queue returns null

readingNumbers: partsDone and recordsSeen are refreshed at each step, not at each raw part: the L3 wake-up list has no per-part call, so the numbers move at enqueue and at the reader's seal.
destination: Same rule as the GIS suggestion (file name as title, file:<sha256> namespace) through intakeDestination with the case's site area; all cuts land in one area by seed key.
